parts.t: Townhomes under $900,000 remain one of the most active and competitive price ranges in the Fraser Valley. This page displays live MLS® listings updated daily, including properties in Surrey, Langley, Cloverdale, and Abbotsford.

For many buyers, this range offers the ideal balance of space, location, and long-term value. Whether you're a first-time buyer, upsizing from a condo, downsizing from a detached home, or investing, there are still excellent opportunities available.

Well-priced townhomes in this bracket can move quickly. If you’d like early access to new listings, upcoming properties, or price-reduced opportunities before they gain traction, feel free to reach out directly.

Townhomes under $900K across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver offer exceptional value for buyers seeking modern living with manageable maintenance at accessible pricing. These properties attract first-time buyers, young families, and downsizers throughout diverse communities from Surrey to Chilliwack, each offering distinct character and amenities.

The market provides impressive variety from compact two-bedroom units perfect for singles or couples to spacious family townhomes with attached garages and multiple levels. Buyers appreciate the opportunity to enter desirable communities, access quality schools and recreation, while avoiding the financial burden and maintenance responsibilities of single-family homes. Many complexes feature contemporary designs, open layouts, and amenities like playgrounds or fitness centers enhancing community living. Strategic location selection balances commuting needs with lifestyle priorities, from transit-oriented urban townhomes to suburban family communities. Whether you're entering the market or seeking easier living, this price range delivers diverse options. Ready to explore? Contact me for current townhome listings under $900K and recent sales across all regions.
